searchText: Will this be like polygon on eth aka you need to bridge to it and its a PoS network? zksync is a rollup not a PoS network I recall when I used rollups before on eth I had to bridge 😅😅 but it was half a year ago so I barely remember it. So I guess no need for extra nodes then. You do have to bridge or swap somehow
